name: An Dan corn noodle
summary: Yellow corn noodle from xã An Dân, Tuy An. Du lịch Phú Yên’s 10 June 2021 article says a batch takes 6–7 days. A later tuna-offal article says 6–7 steps and nearly 10 days. Both stay. The tuna-offal bowl is a separate plate. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Phu Yen. Xã An Dân, huyện Tuy An, on Du lịch Phú Yên’s 10 June 2021 article.
texture: Yellow strands with the sweetness of corn, chewier than a rice noodle. The 10 June 2021 article says one batch takes 6–7 days. The tuna-offal article says 6–7 steps and nearly 10 days. Both stay.
howToEat: The 10 June 2021 article serves the noodle with giò heo, with ốc, in canh chua cá bống, stir-fried with scallion fat or chives and chilli fish sauce and herbs, stir-fried with lòng heo, or in a broth of fish from Đầm Ô Loan with rau ngót.
The simplest plate on that article is the noodle fried with scallion fat or chives, chilli fish sauce, and herbs. The tuna-offal bowl is a different plate. A door and a price are Check on arrival.
where: Xã An Dân, huyện Tuy An. The 10 June 2021 article says households there used to make it, and that one workshop is being brought back. The workshop’s name and a street were not printed. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Bun bap An Dan — corn noodle, 6 to 7 days or nearly 10
seoDescription: Yellow corn noodle from An Dan in Tuy An. One article says 6 to 7 days. Another says nearly 10. A door and a price are Check on arrival.
